results.title: Footer stays sticky at every panel scroll position

steps.title: Given the user is on the "Action Center" page of the Toyota analysis
steps.expected: The "Target Sources" list is displayed with the tabs "All", "Improve visibility", "Improve perception" and the ranked sources
steps.observed: Action Center loaded (org QA-GEO, Toyota). Heading "Target Sources", tabs ALL / IMPROVE VISIBILITY / IMPROVE PERCEPTION (uppercase via CSS), 12 ranked cards + "Show 184 more sources".

steps.title: When the user opens the details panel of the source ranked #1
steps.expected: The details panel opens over the list with a footer showing "Previous" (left), "Source 1 of N" (center) and "Next source" (right)
steps.observed: Panel = <dialog> fixed right (470px). Footer <nav> children: "Previous" | "Source 1 of 196" | "Next source". Header "#1 · frandroid.com".

steps.title: And the user scrolls the panel content to the middle
steps.expected: The articles and prompts scroll under the footer; "Previous", "Source 1 of N" and "Next source" stay visible at the bottom of the panel
steps.observed: Scroll container scrollTop=277/554: footer nav top=837, bottom=900 (= viewport/dialog bottom); Previous, counter and Next source hit-testable (elementFromPoint).

steps.title: And the user scrolls the panel content to the very bottom
steps.expected: The end of "Prompts associated with this source" is reachable and the footer is still visible and not overlapping hidden content
steps.observed: scrollTop=554/554: heading "Prompts associated with this source" present; last element "Show 78 more prompts" bottom=805 <= footer top=837 (not hidden). Footer still at 837-900.

steps.title: Then the user scrolls back to the top of the panel
steps.expected: The footer remains fixed at the bottom of the panel at every scroll position
steps.observed: scrollTop=0: footer still at 837-900. Scroll container bottom=837 = footer top at every position (content scrolls under / above the footer, never overlapped).

results.notes: Footer texts observed: "Previous" / "Source 1 of 196" / "Next source". N=196 (date range "Last 7 days"; precondition mentions 261 for 2026-10-02 - N is generic in the CSV). Sticky measured at scrollTop 0 / 277 / 554 (max): footer bounding box constant y=837..900 inside the 900px viewport.

results.title: Next source swaps panel content in place and syncs the selected card

steps.title: Given the user is on the "Action Center" page of the Toyota analysis in card view
steps.expected: The "Target Sources" cards are displayed in ranked order
steps.observed: Card view active (button "Card view" pressed). Cards in ranked order: 1 frandroid.com, 2 autobild.es, 3 ouest-france.fr, 4 zonebourse.com.

steps.title: And the user opens the details panel of the source ranked #1
steps.expected: The panel header shows "#1 · {domain of card 1}", the footer shows "Source 1 of N" and card #1 shows the selected state
steps.observed: Header "#1 · frandroid.com"; footer "Source 1 of 196"; card #1 aria-pressed="true", bg rgb(224,242,254), border rgb(3,105,161).

steps.title: When the user clicks "Next source"
steps.expected: The panel stays open (no close / reopen) and its content is replaced by the source ranked #2
steps.observed: Same <dialog> node stays open (marker kept, 0 close events). Content replaced by autobild.es.

steps.title: Then the panel header, badges, article tabs and prompts belong to the source of card #2
steps.expected: The header reads "#2 · {domain of card 2}" with its source type and reason badges; the footer reads "Source 2 of N"
steps.observed: Header "#2 · autobild.es | Journalism | Improve visibility | Improve perception"; article tabs "Lack of visibility (21)" / "Negative perception (1)" (were 41 / 5); prompts changed (Spanish prompts of autobild.es); footer "Source 2 of 196".

steps.title: And the selected state behind the panel moved to card #2
steps.expected: Card #2 shows the selected state and card #1 no longer does
steps.observed: Card #2 (autobild.es) aria-pressed="true" + selected background; card #1 aria-pressed="false", white background.

results.notes: Footer: "Source 1 of 196" -> "Source 2 of 196". Panel not closed/reopened (same dialog element, no close transition).

results.title: Counter shows the position within the filtered scope

steps.title: Given the user is on the "Action Center" page of the Toyota analysis
steps.expected: The "Target Sources" list is displayed with the tabs "All", "Improve visibility", "Improve perception" and the ranked sources
steps.observed: Target Sources list displayed with tabs ALL / IMPROVE VISIBILITY / IMPROVE PERCEPTION; ALL scope = 196 sources.

steps.title: When the user selects the "Improve perception" tab
steps.expected: Only sources with the "Improve perception" badge are listed; the user notes their count Y
steps.observed: IMPROVE PERCEPTION tab selected (aria-selected=true): 12 cards + "Show 33 more sources" => Y=45; every card carries the IMPROVE PERCEPTION badge.

steps.title: And the user selects a source type in the source type filter
steps.expected: The list keeps only the sources of that type in the "Improve perception" tab; the user notes the new count Y
steps.test_data: Source type: Journalism (or any type listed with a count)
steps.observed: Source type menu options: All types, Aggregators (4), Corporate (1), Journalism (31), Review Sites (8), Social / UGC (1). Selected "Journalism (31)": 31 cards after expanding, all Journalism + Improve perception => Y=31.

steps.title: And the user opens the details panel of the 2nd source of the filtered list
steps.expected: The details panel opens for that source
steps.observed: 2nd filtered source = guideautoweb.com (global rank #5 in ALL tab). Panel opened: header "#2 · guideautoweb.com".

steps.title: Then the footer counter reads "Source 2 of Y"
steps.expected: The counter shows 2 (position in the filtered list) and Y (number of sources in the filtered list), not the global rank or the 261 total
steps.observed: Footer counter reads "Source 2 of 31" (not 5 / not 196).

steps.title: And the user clicks "Next source"
steps.expected: The panel shows the 3rd source of the filtered list (not the next global rank) and the counter reads "Source 3 of Y"
steps.observed: Next source -> header "#3 · fiches-auto.fr" (3rd of the filtered list; global next would have been #6 caranddriver.com); counter "Source 3 of 31".

results.notes: Counter scope = filtered list: "Source 2 of 31" then "Source 3 of 31" with tab Improve perception + type Journalism. Panel header rank also follows the filtered position (#2, #3).

results.title: Previous is disabled on the first source

steps.title: Given the user is on the "Action Center" page of the Toyota analysis
steps.expected: The "Target Sources" list is displayed with the tabs "All", "Improve visibility", "Improve perception" and the ranked sources
steps.observed: Target Sources list displayed (ALL tab, card view).

steps.title: When the user opens the details panel of the first source of the list
steps.expected: The footer reads "Source 1 of N"
steps.observed: Panel of first source: header "#1 · frandroid.com", footer "Source 1 of 196".

steps.title: Then the "Previous" button is displayed in its disabled state
steps.expected: "Previous" is greyed out while "Next source" stays enabled
steps.observed: Previous: aria-disabled="true", opacity 0.5, cursor not-allowed (native disabled property = false). Next source: aria-disabled="false", opacity 1.

steps.title: And the user clicks the disabled "Previous" button
steps.expected: Nothing happens: the panel still shows the first source and the counter still reads "Source 1 of N" (no jump to the last source)
steps.observed: Forced click on Previous: header still "#1 · frandroid.com", counter still "Source 1 of 196", card #1 still selected (no wrap-around to #196).

results.notes: Disabled state implemented via aria-disabled="true" + opacity 0.5 + cursor not-allowed (no native disabled attribute). Click verified as a no-op.

results.title: Next source is disabled on the last source

steps.title: Given the user is on the "Action Center" page of the Toyota analysis
steps.expected: The "Target Sources" list is displayed
steps.observed: Target Sources list displayed (ALL tab).

steps.title: And the user selects the "Improve perception" tab to get a short list
steps.expected: The filtered list is displayed; the user notes its count N
steps.observed: IMPROVE PERCEPTION tab: 12 cards + "Show 33 more sources" -> expanded to N=45 (last card #45 headtopics.com).

steps.title: When the user opens the details panel of the last source of the list
steps.expected: The footer reads "Source N of N"
steps.observed: Panel of last source: header "#45 · headtopics.com", footer "Source 45 of 45".

steps.title: Then the "Next source" button is displayed in its disabled state
steps.expected: "Next source" is greyed out while "Previous" stays enabled
steps.observed: Next source: aria-disabled="true", opacity 0.5, cursor not-allowed. Previous: aria-disabled="false", opacity 1.

steps.title: And the user clicks the disabled "Next source" button
steps.expected: Nothing happens: the panel still shows the last source and the counter still reads "Source N of N" (no jump to the first source)
steps.observed: Forced click on Next source: header still "#45 · headtopics.com", counter still "Source 45 of 45" (no jump to #1); card headtopics.com still selected.

results.notes: Footer on last source: "Previous" / "Source 45 of 45" / "Next source" (Next source aria-disabled). Click verified as a no-op.

results.title: Previous and Next source work in the list view overlay

steps.title: Given the user is on the "Action Center" page of the Toyota analysis
steps.expected: The "Target Sources" list is displayed
steps.observed: Target Sources list displayed (card view): 1 frandroid.com, 2 autobild.es, 3 ouest-france.fr, 4 zonebourse.com, 5 guideautoweb.com.

steps.title: And the user switches to the list (table) view
steps.expected: The sources are displayed as table rows in the same ranked order as the cards
steps.observed: List view button pressed: table rows <tr data-source-domain> in the same order (1 frandroid.com, 2 autobild.es, 3 ouest-france.fr, 4 zonebourse.com, 5 guideautoweb.com, 6 caranddriver.com).

steps.title: When the user opens the details panel of the row ranked #1
steps.expected: The panel opens over the table with the footer "Previous" (disabled), "Source 1 of N" and "Next source"; row #1 shows the selected state
steps.observed: Panel over table: header "#1 · frandroid.com"; footer "Previous / Source 1 of 196 / Next source"; Previous aria-disabled="true" (opacity 0.5); row #1 aria-selected="true" (bg rgb(224,242,254)).

steps.title: And the user clicks "Next source"
steps.expected: The panel stays open and shows "#2 · {domain of row 2}"; the counter reads "Source 2 of N"; row #2 shows the selected state and row #1 no longer does
steps.observed: Same dialog stays open (0 close events); header "#2 · autobild.es"; counter "Source 2 of 196"; row #2 aria-selected="true", row #1 aria-selected="false".

steps.title: Then the user clicks "Previous"
steps.expected: The panel shows "#1 · {domain of row 1}" again; the counter reads "Source 1 of N"; row #1 is selected again
steps.observed: Header "#1 · frandroid.com"; counter "Source 1 of 196"; row #1 aria-selected="true" again, row #2 false; Previous disabled again.

results.notes: List view overlay behaves like card view: in-place swap, row selection synced via aria-selected.
